_doc: M4 enemies (PLAN §2: Skitterkin are the home world's family; other families arrive with other planets). Speeds in metres a second (a cell is 0.5 m, a tick 1/20 s) — the cell's walk % applies (shallow water slows them), a road or bridge multiplies by `family.road`. `reach` = melee reach in cells (`range` for a spitter's acid). `damage` per bite every `cooldown` ticks. `wall` multiplies damage to walls and gates (a gnasher chews). `acid: true` = its damage is acid (Wall level IV shrugs most of it off). `size`: small / medium / large (M10 trains plow small and medium). `remains` = the stain it leaves. `burst` = [radius, power] of a blast when it dies (none = 0).

skitterkin.name: Skitterkin
skitterkin.about: Chitin crawlers of the home world. Nests in the woods; drawn by noise.
